verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an observability SaaS that stores customer telemetry, so the axis applies. The pack does not document retention periods, retention configuration, or data deletion. The only related material is community reports that log collection can be disabled in the Data Management Hub or via environment variables, which controls ingest rather than retention or deletion and so earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
